same_launch_openai.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agent payments
same_launch_openai.text: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet, enabling agents to pay without card details. Pro users in the US can approve each purchase with biometrics via Amex, Mastercard, and Visa.

same_launch_techcrunch.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents check out securely
same_launch_techcrunch.text: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets agents complete checkout without exposing card numbers. US ChatGPT Pro subscribers approve Face ID-gated payments; Amex, Mastercard, and Visa are partners.

followup_wallet.title: ChatGPT Wallet expands to enterprise seats next month
followup_wallet.text: Following the consumer ChatGPT Wallet launch, OpenAI says enterprise seats will gain agent checkout next month with admin spend controls and audit logs. Card details remain tokenized.

generic_ai_a.title: Why AI startups are raising again
generic_ai_a.text: Venture investors discuss capital returning to AI application startups after a quiet summer. The piece surveys fundraising sentiment without announcing a specific product.

generic_ai_b.title: OpenAI competitors jockey for enterprise share
generic_ai_b.text: A broad market overview of enterprise AI assistants from multiple vendors. No single product launch is announced; the article compares sales motions and procurement trends.

gemini_hydrogen.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
gemini_hydrogen.text: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen for rapid execution in agentic workflows. Early testing cites faster coding tasks and lower token usage versus prior Gemini Flash-class models.
